name: define
title: parts.define
lead: Declares a named part and its generator; nothing runs on load. A generator runs on request, or when its code changes.

usedIn.quote: `parts.define` declares a named part whose generator runs on request.
| `PART_OVERLAP` | advice | two parts (`parts.define`) overlap without one inside the other: regenerating either rewrites the other |
